backtest_protocol: docs/backtesting.md canonical three fixed windows. Core uses canonical snapshots; Space variants use the same exp-20260510-028 augmented snapshots. The accepted_before variant reproduces exp-20260511-105 policy semantics.

before_variant.description: accepted exp-20260511-105 semantics: RKLB/ASTS trend_long uses 7 ATR, other official Space trend_long signals use 5 ATR

best_variant.description: only LUNR/RDW lunar-manufacturing trend_long signals use a 7 ATR target; RKLB/ASTS remain at accepted 7 ATR and all other official Space trend signals remain at 5 ATR

decision_rationale: LUNR/RDW trend target extension did not beat the accepted exp-105 Space stack under the three-window gate. Keep non-launch official Space trend signals at the accepted 5 ATR target.

gate_questions.acceptance_standard: Must improve aggregate EV and PnL versus exp-105, improve EV in at least two windows with no EV regression, keep max drawdown drift <= 0.5 pp, and survival >= 5%.
gate_questions.alpha_hypothesis: Bucket-specific lifecycle convexity for lunar/manufacturing Space trend_long entries.
prior_similar_experiments: exp-20260511-032 accepted 5 ATR for all official Space trend signals.
exp-20260511-037 rejected wider targets for official Space breakouts.
exp-20260511-038 rejected narrowing the 5 ATR Space trend target scope.
exp-20260511-105 accepted 7 ATR only for RKLB/ASTS launch-connectivity trend signals.
gate_questions.reproducibility: This script reruns core, accepted exp-105 Space stack, and LUNR/RDW target variants across the three docs/backtesting.md fixed snapshots.
gate_questions.single_causal_variable: Only LUNR/RDW trend target ATR multiple changes; all other Space target/risk semantics are locked.

hypothesis: RDW/LUNR lunar and space-manufacturing trend winners may deserve a wider target than the accepted 5 ATR all-non-launch Space trend target, while the accepted RKLB/ASTS 7 ATR launch-connectivity target remains fixed.

llm_metrics.why_not_llm_soft_ranking: Space forward event ledger still lacks enough mature closed decisions; this run uses deterministic OHLCV lifecycle replay.

next_evidence_needed: If rejected, do not retry nearby LUNR/RDW trend target widths on the same frozen snapshots; future work needs forward replacement value by catalyst bucket or a genuinely new official event-quality field.
rejection_reason: LUNR/RDW trend target extension did not beat the accepted exp-105 Space stack under the three-window gate. Keep non-launch official Space trend signals at the accepted 5 ATR target.
single_causal_variable: target ATR multiple for LUNR/RDW lunar-manufacturing trend_long signals inside the default-off official Space sleeve

lunar_manufacturing_6_0.description: only LUNR/RDW lunar-manufacturing trend_long signals use a 6 ATR target; RKLB/ASTS remain at accepted 7 ATR and all other official Space trend signals remain at 5 ATR
